让 Agent 在公司干活，最大麻烦是它不懂内部规矩

比如某个指标怎么算、数据该去哪张表查、文档用哪版页眉。这些门道散在老员工脑子和聊天记录里，Agent 每次开工都像第一天入职。

LangChain 公开了他们内部搭「知识工厂」的做法：干活的 Agent 边做边报错，后台再配一个「馆长 Agent」定期改知识库。

他们专门拆开来做，原因很直接：如果让干活的 Agent 顺手改知识库，它一心想着把眼前任务交差，改着改着规则就会乱套、前后打架；靠人手工维护又是个无底洞。

拆成两头各管一摊就顺了：

- 白天干活的 Agent：遇到某列改了名、规矩对不上，像提工单一样标出哪里错、建议怎么改，标完接着把眼下的活做完
- 后台「馆长 Agent」：按固定节奏运行，统一翻看这些报错标记、Agent 运行轨迹，再对照 Slack 和 Notion 里的原始资料，把技能和文档改对

原文举了个写营收报告的例子：白天 Agent 发现 BigQuery 里有一列改了名，标出来后继续把报告写完；报告写完，财务负责人和它一起改格式，要求今后所有文档都换新页眉。当晚后台 Agent 读到标记和这段对话，就把「取数」和「写报告」两个技能一起更新了，下次干活直接生效。

存的时候也不用把所有数据搬进知识库。原文说，像 Snowflake、Databricks 这类数据底座里已有完整最新的正本，放原处现查就行，知识库里只攒三样东西：怎么按公司规矩做事的技能、核心业务知识、写明「数据在哪怎么查」的取数指南。

LangChain 说他们内部的销售 Agent 和做设计物料的 Content Studio 都在跑这套回路：销售在 Slack 里改邮件草稿，系统会在改动够大时按人提炼偏好并每周压缩一次记忆；设计 Agent 每做完一单提炼最多 5 条有证据的教训，后面的活给这些教训打分，每周由后台把证明有用的并进技能和 wiki。

起步不用等公司文档全写完，挑一个反复要做的活，把「干活报错 + 后台整理」的回路接上就能转。文中没给出这套做法具体省了多少人力成本或返工时间。
完整内容：https://xiaohu.ai/article/langchain-knowledge-factory/

A year ago I lost my 9-5 corporate job.
12 months later and I am still here, now running my own business.

It was very hard losing a stable job, especially one that was sponsoring a work visa and my future in the US.

I was building a new life, and it was completely taken away in a flash.

However, working for myself...has been amazing. A huge success for me.

Not a mindblowing massive financial success, but:

1. I am able to eat, live, pay my bills and travel.

2. I've worked with some of the biggest brands in the world like Google.

3. Spoken on stage across Australia and even at Upscale Conf in San Francisco.

4. Post hundreds of different videos and tutorial content across all many social media platforms.

Most importantly, I've had more time back for myself here at home in Melbourne.

My physical and mental health has improved, I am getting closer to having a daily routine and a more stable situation.

I don't know what things will be like in 12 months time, but I am just so appreciative of the support everyone has given me to turn things around.

However, working for myself...has been amazing. A huge success for me.

Not a mindblowing massive financial success, but:

1. I am able to eat, live, pay my bills and travel.

2. I've worked with some of the biggest brands in the world like Google.

3. Spoken on stage across Australia and even at Upscale Conf in San Francisco.

4. Post hundreds of different videos and tutorial content across all many social media platforms.

Most importantly, I've had more time back for myself here at home in Melbourne.

My physical and mental health has improved, I am getting closer to having a daily routine and a more stable situation.

I don't know what things will be like in 12 months time, but I am just so appreciative of the support everyone has given me to turn things around.
